source: JoYi Rhys, The First 30 Days, Simple Sequences & The Moxie Sequence v1, 2026-08-09

mountain.cue: Press down through the four corners of each foot, and let the floor press back up into you.

easyseat.cue: Let your sit bones be heavy, your spine be tall, and let the breath keep you company.

catcow.cue: Let your spine arch and round at the pace of your own breath.

child.cue: Let the floor support you. Rest is a legitimate posture, not a retreat.

tabletop.cue: Bring hands under shoulders and knees under hips. Let the base teach before the pose does.

birddog.cue: Reach the opposite arm and leg long. Your first balance keeps the floor close.

dog.cue: Bent knees are the pose. Make space through your spine before asking anything of your heels.

cobra.cue: Keep it low and supported. Let your legs work so your lower back does not have to.

lowlunge.cue: Let the back knee rest on the mat. Knee down is the pose.

forwardfold.cue: Bend your knees generously and let your head hang heavy. The floor is not the prize.

warrior.cue: Let your legs make the pose possible. Take up space without apology.

sideangle.cue: Rest a forearm on your thigh or bring a hand to a block. Support is strength.

triangle.cue: Choose length before depth. Let a block bring the floor to you.

tree.cue: Place your foot at the ankle, calf, or thigh, never the knee. The wall is welcome.

halfwaylift.cue: Bring hands to shins, hinge from your hips, lengthen your spine, and let your gaze stay down.

seatedfold.cue: Fold from your hips with soft knees. A bolster under the knees is real teaching.

seatedtwist.cue: Sit tall before turning gently. Practice both directions without forcing the shape.

plank.cue: Press the floor away. Lower your knees whenever that gives you the steadier base.

savasana.cue: Let effort drain toward the floor. This is practice. This is enough.

day-01.title: Day 1 · Mountain
day-01.intro: Begin with the ground and the shape of standing.
day-01.outro: Notice what changed when you stood with attention.

day-02.title: Day 2 · Easy Seat and the Breath
day-02.intro: The seat is the practice today.
day-02.outro: One steady seat is enough for today.

day-03.title: Day 3 · Cat-Cow
day-03.intro: Let the breath introduce movement to the spine.
day-03.outro: Let the last breath be quieter than the first.

day-04.title: Day 4 · Child's Pose
day-04.intro: Learn the posture that is always available to you.

day-05.title: Day 5 · Week One Integration
day-05.intro: Link the shapes you already know.
day-05.outro: Review is how the practice becomes yours.

day-08.title: Day 8 · Tabletop
day-08.intro: Build the base through hands and knees.
day-08.outro: Let your wrists and shoulders become quiet again.

day-09.title: Day 9 · Balancing Table
day-09.intro: Try a first balance with the floor close.

day-10.title: Day 10 · Downward Dog
day-10.intro: Make space through the spine before asking for depth.
day-10.outro: Bent knees and a spacious spine are complete practice.

day-12.title: Day 12 · Low Lunge
day-12.intro: Let support make room through the hips.

day-13.title: Day 13 · Standing Forward Fold
day-13.outro: Let the head stay heavy for one last breath.

day-14.title: Day 14 · Floor Integration
day-14.intro: Link the floor poses at the pace of your breath.
day-14.outro: The links between poses are part of the practice.

day-15.title: Day 15 · Warrior II
day-15.intro: Build the pose from the ground up.
day-15.outro: Let your legs remember the steadiness.

day-18.title: Day 18 · Tree
day-18.intro: Practice balance as a conversation with the floor.
day-18.outro: The wall and the wobble both belong.

day-19.title: Day 19 · Standing Integration
day-19.intro: Let transitions turn shapes into movement.
day-19.outro: Move with the breath you have.

day-20.title: Day 20 · Mini-Flow
day-20.intro: Link mountain, Warrior II, and side angle on the breath.
day-20.outro: Take up space, then let the floor receive you.

day-22.title: Day 22 · Your Four-Pose Sequence
day-22.intro: Practice four foundational shapes you already own.

day-23.title: Day 23 · Half Sun Salutation
day-23.intro: Learn the hinge that connects standing and folding.

day-24.title: Day 24 · Sun Salutation, Level One
day-24.intro: Build heat without chaturanga and without anything to prove.
day-24.outro: Knees down is a complete way through.

day-25.title: Day 25 · Seated Closing
day-25.intro: Close close to the floor, with support.
day-25.outro: Turn both directions, then let the body be still.

moxie-sequence.title: The Moxie Sequence
moxie-sequence.outro: Take one steady breath. This is practice. This is enough.

day-26.title: Day 26 · The Full Sequence, Fully Guided
day-26.intro: Move through the complete sequence with every approved teaching cue.
day-26.outro: Take one steady breath. This is practice. This is enough.

day-27.title: Day 27 · The Full Sequence, Lighter Cues
day-27.intro: Let familiar shapes carry more of the practice today.

day-28.title: Day 28 · Personal Emphasis
day-28.intro: Move through the full sequence and give more time to the section that is asking for your attention.
day-28.outro: Let your own emphasis count as part of the practice.

day-29.title: Day 29 · The Quiet Run
day-29.intro: Follow the familiar order with breath counts and no additional pose instruction.
day-29.outro: Let the quiet show you what you know.

day-30.title: Day 30 · The Moxie Sequence
day-30.intro: Graduation is proof, not a test. You can hold your ground.
day-30.outro: Take one steady breath. This is practice. This is enough.

morning-stretch.outro: Carry one steady breath into the morning.
